commitment.heading: Our Commitment to Quality and Your Satisfaction
paragraphs: At Ecotwist Innovtions Private Limited, we are dedicated to offering high-quality, sustainable products that meet and exceed your expectations. This detailed Return and Refund Policy is designed to be a transparent and fair guide. This policy is governed by the principles of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, and all other applicable laws in India.

rightToReturn.heading: Right to Return: Conditions and Timeframes
rightToReturn.text: You have the right to request a return within
rightToReturn.textEnd: from the date your product was delivered, as verified by the delivery date recorded by our shipping partner.
points: The item must be returned in its original, unused state with all tags, labels, accessories, and protective packaging intact.
You must provide the original sales invoice or the unique order number associated with your purchase.

sections.heading: Valid Reasons for Initiating a Return

labelledPoints.label: Damaged or Defective Product:
labelledPoints.text: Product is physically damaged, broken, or has a manufacturing defect.

labelledPoints.label: Incorrect Product Delivered:
labelledPoints.text: Wrong model, size, color, or other specifications.

labelledPoints.label: Product Not as Described:
labelledPoints.text: Actual features differ materially from description/images on website.

sections.heading: Products Excluded from Our Return Policy
paragraphs: Certain products cannot be returned unless defective or damaged upon delivery:

steps.label: Initiate Contact:
steps.textAfterEmail: within 7 days with subject line "Return Request - Order #[Your Order Number]".

steps.label: Provide Necessary Information:
steps.text: Include product name, quantity, reason for return, and attach clear photos/videos.

steps.label: Receive RA Number:
steps.text: Once approved, you'll receive a Return Authorization number and instructions.

steps.label: Ship the Product:
steps.text: Free reverse pickup will be arranged. If unavailable, self-ship and we'll reimburse shipping costs.

refundProcedure.heading: Our Refund Procedure
paragraphs: Once we receive your returned item, we will conduct a thorough quality check and inspection:

labelledPoints.label: Inspection and Approval:
labelledPoints.text: Done within 48 business hours of receipt.

labelledPoints.label: Refund Processing:
labelledPoints.text: Refund to original payment method (excluding shipping fees unless error on our part).

labelledPoints.label: Timeline:
labelledPoints.text: Up to 7 business days for refund to reflect.

cancellation.heading: Order Cancellation
cancellation.text: You may cancel your order before dispatch by emailing
cancellation.textEnd: Orders already shipped cannot be cancelled and must follow the return process.

disclaimer: Disclaimer: This policy is a binding agreement between you and Ecotwist Innovtions Private Limited. We reserve the right to amend or update this policy at any time.
